verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway's Vault entity explicitly lets platform engineers store secrets outside plaintext config, referencing them via environment variables, Konnect Config Store, or supported third-party vault backends (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), keeping credentials out of shared declarative files. Docs explicitly state secrets 'aren't visible in plaintext throughout the platform.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of vault integration in production and broader list of supported third-party backends.
